verifiers.description: Confirms reassignment to the Tokyo agent, escalation fields, and priority/state for the specific case.

verifiers.name: Old Low-Priority SLAs Removed
verifiers.description: Ensures previous low-priority SLA links (Response-Low sla_def_id = 4, Resolution-Low sla_def_id = 9) are removed from the case.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_slas_remaining FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 122 AND sla_def_id IN (4, 9);

verifiers.name: High Priority SLA Set Applied (Response + Resolution)
verifiers.description: Ensures both High SLAs are active on the escalated case —  SLA Response - High (No Pause) (sla_def_id = 11),  SLA Resolution - High (sla_def_id = 7). Both must be in stage in_progress.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_sla_applied FROM case_sla WHERE case_id = 122 AND sla_def_id IN (7, 11) AND stage = 'in_progress';
